goal: Minimize reasoning dead time without paid API or always-on user PC while preserving disposable-worker semantics and single substantive authority.

layers.mechanism: Current owner checkpoints meaningful work and emits one next-generation event on dedicated PR lane before observed runtime boundary.

Keep the existing +780s provisional cold-rescue arm. Near bounded close, mutate the same canonical due to a predictive boundary before target close. Predecessor continues useful work; an early successor fences and cannot claim conflicting substantive authority until safe transfer/close is durable.
layers.promotion: two safe <=42s handoffs, then valid fixed 900s utilization window

layers.target_latency: normal close + 60s due plus scheduler jitter; cold rescue at +780s plus jitter
layers.mechanism: One hourly RRULE canonical mutates only DTSTART. Fixed quarter rotation is retired.
layers.live_evidence: Production automatic reentry observed about 64s after durable due in UTIL-EXP-011.
layers.p0_limitation: With 600s useful turns, a nominal 60s post-close gap alone gives 90.91% idealized steady-state coverage, below the 93.33% P0 target before jitter/startup. Therefore this remains safety fallback but is not sufficient as the optimized normal path.

layers.target_latency: 5-minute minimum cadence plus unbounded documented schedule delay

nonnegotiable_invariants: GitHub main is durable source of truth
duplicate wake never implies duplicate substantive side effect
predictive overlap never implies dual substantive authority
wake event alone never advances authority
no secrets in public event lane
780s provisional cold-rescue horizon remains intact during predictive-prearm canary
same canonical remains enabled until program terminal or explicit operator stop

capability_evidence.rolling_rrule: Controlled +2m canary PASS plus production completion-relative automatic reentry; one scheduler-delay sample approximately 64s after due.
capability_evidence.epoch59_execution: 557 strict useful seconds over 626 wall seconds, showing in-turn execution improved enough for cross-turn latency to become the dominant measured constraint.
capability_evidence.p0_budget: 840/900 requires 93.33% useful coverage; a 600s turn permits about 42.9s average non-useful cross-turn loss.

current_blocker: Normal scheduler delivery latency is too large for the P0 budget when paid entirely after predecessor close. No active independent event consumer exists, so predictive same-canonical prearm is the highest-effect currently available canary.
next_test: Complete PREARM-CANARY-001 and directly measure predecessor-last-useful -> successor-first-useful gap, early-overlap fence behavior, duplicate-side-effect absence, and schedule rollback absence.
